notice: Original EduWonderLab classroom practice. Not official WIDA or ACCESS content.

worlds.name: Signal Station
worlds.description: Dispatch messages arrive from classrooms, science teams, and the community. Listen, update the station display, and follow the evidence into a new mission.
worlds.focus: Listen for details, sequence, purpose, and changes

worlds.name: Evidence City
worlds.description: Reports, charts, and community voices help investigators answer real questions. Choose a source, gather evidence, and open a reading investigation.
worlds.focus: Find evidence, connect sources, and explain ideas

worlds.name: Conversation Quest
worlds.description: Join a science team, planning meeting, or classroom discussion. Rehearse an idea, record or reflect, then continue in the Speaking Studio.
worlds.focus: Explain, clarify, compare, and build on ideas

worlds.name: StoryWorks
worlds.description: Turn observations and evidence into writing for a real audience. Pick a writing challenge, draft and revise in the Writing Studio.
worlds.focus: Plan, develop, revise, and communicate for a reader
